caption:
Americans now owe $1.263 trillion on credit cards. 💳

The New York Fed's latest report says about 7% of card balances moved into serious delinquency (90+ days) in Q2 2026.

In plain English: a lot of people are stretched thin, and it's not always about overspending.

Are your card balances higher or lower than a year ago?
